archetypes.name: dyn-lint-parser
archetypes.rationale: The new manual frontmatter parser and text heuristics are the main correctness risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new agent tool-contract lint for parser edge cases, especially inline lists, block lists, scalar tools values, malformed frontmatter, and suppression handling. Check that findings are emitted only when an explicit Read-less list and body read intent coincide. Confirm stdout and exit-code behavior matches the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
